frequency_grid.algorithm: Gauss-Legendre quadrature with rational frequency transform

catalogue: vibeqc.dispersion_d4_reference_systems.all_reference_systems; per-element records sorted stably by nominal_cn

CH.label: C/CH-doublet
CH.response_checks: Integral Aufbau occupations; positive-definite A+B and A-B response matrices.

partitioning: Caldeweyher et al., JCP 150, 154122 (2019), Eq.5; subtract each partner charge-scaled canonical atomic spectrum and divide by the number of equivalent target atoms.
charge_model: Native EEQ for reference charges and partner scaling.
coordination_numbers: Nominal catalogue CNs; explicit per-reference Gaussian counts follow nominal-environment multiplicities.
copper: Neutral Cu and CuH atomic reference records retained from d4_reference_copper_protocol.json; Cu cross coefficients recomputed with the updated light-element spectra.
source: Independent vibe-qc RKS/UKS and coupled response. No external polarizability table or external charge values included.
scope: Improved native post-SCF D4-style model. Self-consistent GFN2 dispersion, upstream reference coverage and full heavier-element acceptance remain incomplete.
period3: Na-Ar records (23 stored, from 24 closed-shell hosts; the Na/NaH record is withheld) added 2026-10-26 by the same protocol; the light-element and Cu records are unchanged and their cross coefficients with period 3 are Casimir-Polder quadratures against the frozen spectra. See d4_reference_period3_protocol.json.
